howToPlay: Alternate between the forward dash and wide slash attacks to control the field. Use the Super at the right moment to deal heavy damage while staying invulnerable. Balance aggression with recovery by utilizing healing gadgets and damage reduction.
gears: Equip SPEED to capitalize on the assassin playstyle and DAMAGE to finish off low-health targets. SHIELD is also recommended to compensate for the base health pool.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer high-risk, high-reward combat and masters of timing invulnerability.
